items.summary: Apigee Edge for Public CloudAnnouncementOn November 11, 2026, we began releasing Edge UI updates for Apigee Edge forPublic Cloud.FixedBug IDComponentDescription392653797, 399185014Edge UIFixed an issue where navigating to the App Details or New App pages in organizations with a large number of API products experienced slowness or UI freezing during the initial page load. The Edge UI now fetches API products on demand when you open the Add Product dialog, improving initial page load performance.576859695Edge UIFixed an issue in the Analytics Error Code Analysis dashboard where 504 Gateway Timeout responses caused by target timeouts were excluded from the Proxy errors charts. Target timeout 504 responses are now counted under Proxy errors.188163219Edge UIFixed a UI formatting issue in the Analytics Custom Reports list view so that dimensions display without overlapping.Gemini Enterprise Agent PlatformFeatureGovern agents on any CNCF-conformant Kubernetes cluster with Agent Gateway for cross-cloud (Limited Preview)Agent Gateway for cross-cloudis available inLimited Preview. ItextendsAgent Platform governance to agents that run on Cloud Native ComputingFoundation (CNCF)-conformant Kubernetes clusters outside of Google Cloud, suchas Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), Azure Kubernetes Service(AKS), Red Hat OpenShift, and bare-metal clusters. Youragents keep running where they are, but you govern them from one place: giveeach agent a verifiable identity, register agents and MCP servers in AgentRegistry, and route their LLM, MCP, and A2A traffic through local Agent Gatewayproxies by using your existing service mesh or network stack. Those proxiesenforce access and Model Armor safety policies, and send access logs and agenttraces to Cloud Logging and Cloud Trace.Agent Gateway for cross-cloud is available at no charge during Limited Preview.Other products that you configure with it, such as Model Armor, Cloud Logging, andCloud Trace, are billed at their standard rates. To request access, complete theaccess request form.For more information, seeSet up Agent Gateway for cross-cloud.Oracle Database@Google CloudFeatureFor Exadata VM Clusters and Exascale VM Clusters, you can now choose to create a cluster without an Identity Connector, and enable or disable the Identity Connector after the cluster is created by using the Google Cloud console, the gcloud CLI, or the API. For more information, see Enable and disable Identity Connector.This feature is generally available (GA).
